JPMorgan Chase (JPM) is confirmed to report earnings on Tuesday, October 13, 2026 at approximately 6:40 AM ET. The consensus earnings estimate is $5.88 per share on revenue of $51.85 billion, a decline of 27.9% year-over-year, and the Earnings Whisper ® number is $6.10 per share. Investors are 5.7% bullish going into the company's earnings release. Option traders are pricing in a 2.7% move on earnings and the stock has averaged a 2.4% move in recent quarters.
